logical_finding: Downstream dependence can arise from the described process, a selected template, discourse selection or a separate operator while the candidate merely means then. The stated simple-sequence null adds unjustified independence. Candidate-associated dependence therefore does not identify lexical causality. Conversely a causal connective can describe the same eventual outcome as a sequential connective; its use does not physically cause the downstream state.
